name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.IsMathieuSubspace.comap
statement:
theorem IsMathieuSubspace.comap {M : Submodule K B} (hM : IsMathieuSubspace M)
    (φ : A →ₐ[K] B) : IsMathieuSubspace (M.comap φ.toLinearMap)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.counterexample_pullback
statement:
theorem counterexample_pullback (φ : A →ₐ[K] B) (I : A →ₗ[K] K) (J : B →ₗ[K] K)
    (hcompat : ∀ f, J (φ f) = I f) (f h : A)
    (hpure : ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → I (f ^ m) = 0)
    (hmarked : ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → I (h * f ^ m) ≠ 0) :
    ¬ IsMathieuSubspace (LinearMap.ker J)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.not_isMathieuSubspace_of_witness
statement:
theorem not_isMathieuSubspace_of_witness (M : Submodule K A) (f h : A)
    (hpure : ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → f ^ m ∈ M)
    (hmarked : ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → h * f ^ m ∉ M) :
    ¬ IsMathieuSubspace M

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.bernstein_average
statement:
theorem bernstein_average (n : ℕ) (z : ℂ) :
    (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, ((1-(x : ℂ)) + (x : ℂ)*z)^n) =
      (1/(n+1 : ℂ)) * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n+1), z^k

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.bernstein_integral
statement:
theorem bernstein_integral (m j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ m) :
    ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, (m.choose j : ℂ) * (t : ℂ) ^ j * (1 - (t : ℂ)) ^ (m - j) =
      1 / (m + 1 : ℂ)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.scalarLaurent_C_mul_coeff
statement:
theorem scalarLaurent_C_mul_coeff (c : ℂ) (f : ScalarLaurent) (k : ℤ) :
    (LaurentPolynomial.C c * f).coeff k = c * f.coeff k

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.scalarLaurent_mul_T_coeff
statement:
theorem scalarLaurent_mul_T_coeff (f : ScalarLaurent) (i k : ℤ) :
    (f * LaurentPolynomial.T i).coeff k = f.coeff (k - i)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.xzA_geometric_sum
statement:
theorem xzA_geometric_sum (m : ℕ) :
    xzA * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (LaurentPolynomial.T (j : ℤ) : ScalarLaurent) =
      LaurentPolynomial.T (m : ℤ) - LaurentPolynomial.T (-1)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.xzA_pow_coeff_bottom
statement: theorem xzA_pow_coeff_bottom (m : ℕ) : (xzA ^ m).coeff (-(m : ℤ)) = (-1 : ℂ) ^ m

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.xzA_pow_coeff_outside
statement:
theorem xzA_pow_coeff_outside (m : ℕ) (k : ℤ) (hk : k < -(m : ℤ) ∨ 0 < k) :
    (xzA ^ m).coeff k = 0

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.xzA_pow_coeff_succ
statement:
theorem xzA_pow_coeff_succ (m : ℕ) (k : ℤ) :
    (xzA ^ (m + 1)).coeff k = (xzA ^ m).coeff k - (xzA ^ m).coeff (k + 1)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.xzFamily_integral_marked
statement:
theorem xzFamily_integral_marked (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, (xzFamily (t : ℂ) ^ m).coeff 1 = (-1 : ℂ) ^ (m - 1) / (m + 1 : ℂ)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.xzFamily_integral_pure
statement:
theorem xzFamily_integral_pure (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, (xzFamily (t : ℂ) ^ m).coeff 0 = 0

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.xzFamily_integrated_coeff
statement:
theorem xzFamily_integrated_coeff (m : ℕ) (k : ℤ) :
    ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, (xzFamily (t : ℂ) ^ m).coeff k =
      (1 / (m + 1 : ℂ)) * (xzA ^ m * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), LaurentPolynomial.T (j : ℤ)).coeff k

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.xzFamily_pow
statement:
theorem xzFamily_pow (t : ℂ) (m : ℕ) :
    xzFamily t ^ m = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1),
      LaurentPolynomial.C ((m.choose j : ℂ) * t ^ j * (1 - t) ^ (m - j)) *
        (xzA ^ m * LaurentPolynomial.T (j : ℤ))

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.MatrixRepresentation.coefficient_apply
statement:
theorem coefficient_apply (ρ : MatrixRepresentation G ι) (a v : ι → ℂ) (g : G) :
    ρ.coefficient a v g = ∑ i, ∑ j, a i * (ρ.toMonoidHom g i j) * v j

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.MatrixRepresentation.coefficient_conj
statement:
theorem coefficient_conj (ρ : MatrixRepresentation G ι) (a v : ι → ℂ) :
    star (ρ.coefficient a v) = ρ.conjugate.coefficient (star a) (star v)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.MatrixRepresentation.coefficient_mul
statement:
theorem coefficient_mul (ρ : MatrixRepresentation G ι) (σ : MatrixRepresentation G κ)
    (a v : ι → ℂ) (b w : κ → ℂ) :
    ρ.coefficient a v * σ.coefficient b w =
      (ρ.tensor σ).coefficient (fun p => a p.1 * b p.2) (fun p => v p.1 * w p.2)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.MatrixRepresentation.coefficient_ofRepresentation
statement:
theorem coefficient_ofRepresentation (b : Module.Basis ι ℂ V) (ρ : Representation ℂ G V)
    (hρ : ∀ v, Continuous fun g => ρ g v) (l : V →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ) (v : V) (g : G) :
    (ofRepresentation b ρ hρ).coefficient (fun i => l (b i)) (b.repr v) g = l (ρ g v)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.MatrixRepresentation.conjugate_action
statement:
theorem conjugate_action (ρ : MatrixRepresentation G ι) (g : G) (v : ι → ℂ) :
    ρ.conjugate.toRepresentation g (star v) = star (ρ.toRepresentation g v)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.MatrixRepresentation.continuous_action
statement:
theorem continuous_action (ρ : MatrixRepresentation G ι) :
    Continuous fun p : G × (ι → ℂ) => ρ.toRepresentation p.1 p.2

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.MatrixRepresentation.continuous_orbit
statement:
theorem continuous_orbit (ρ : MatrixRepresentation G ι) (v : ι → ℂ) :
    Continuous fun g => ρ.toRepresentation g v

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.MatrixRepresentation.entry_as_coefficient
statement:
theorem entry_as_coefficient (ρ : MatrixRepresentation G ι) (i j : ι) (g : G) :
    ρ.entry i j g = (ρ.toRepresentation g (Pi.single j 1)) i

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.MatrixRepresentation.entry_conjugate
statement:
theorem entry_conjugate (ρ : MatrixRepresentation G ι) (i j : ι) :
    ρ.conjugate.entry i j = star (ρ.entry i j)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.MatrixRepresentation.entry_pullback
statement:
theorem entry_pullback (ρ : MatrixRepresentation H ι) (π : G →* H) (hπ : Continuous π)
    (i j : ι) : (ρ.pullback π hπ).entry i j = (ρ.entry i j).comp ⟨π, hπ⟩

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.MatrixRepresentation.entry_reindex
statement:
@[simp] theorem entry_reindex (ρ : MatrixRepresentation G ι) (e : ι ≃ κ) (i j : ι) :
    (ρ.reindex e).entry (e i) (e j) = ρ.entry i j

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.MatrixRepresentation.entry_tensor
statement:
theorem entry_tensor (ρ : MatrixRepresentation G ι) (σ : MatrixRepresentation G κ)
    (i j : ι) (k l : κ) :
    (ρ.tensor σ).entry (i, k) (j, l) = ρ.entry i j * σ.entry k l

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.MatrixRepresentation.tensor_toMatrix
statement:
theorem tensor_toMatrix (ρ : MatrixRepresentation G ι) (σ : MatrixRepresentation G κ) (g : G) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix ((Pi.basisFun ℂ ι).tensorProduct (Pi.basisFun ℂ κ))
      ((Pi.basisFun ℂ ι).tensorProduct (Pi.basisFun ℂ κ))
      (ρ.toRepresentation.tprod σ.toRepresentation g) = (ρ.tensor σ).toMonoidHom g

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.coefficient_mem_representative
statement:
theorem coefficient_mem_representative {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (ρ : MatrixRepresentation G ι) (a v : ι → ℂ) :
    ρ.coefficient a v ∈ representativeFunctions (G := G)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.entry_mem_representative
statement:
theorem entry_mem_representative {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (ρ : MatrixRepresentation G ι) (i j : ι) : ρ.entry i j ∈ representativeSubmodule G

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.representative_algebra
statement:
theorem representative_algebra :
    (representativeStarAlgebra (G := G)).toSubalgebra.toSubmodule =
      Submodule.span ℂ (continuousRepresentationCoefficients G)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.representative_comp
statement:
theorem representative_comp {f : C(H, ℂ)} (hf : f ∈ representativeFunctions (G := H))
    (π : G →* H) (hπ : Continuous π) :
    f.comp ⟨π, hπ⟩ ∈ representativeFunctions (G := G)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.representative_eq_span_coefficients
statement:
theorem representative_eq_span_coefficients : representativeSubmodule G =
    Submodule.span ℂ (continuousRepresentationCoefficients G)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.representative_mul
statement:
theorem representative_mul {f h : C(G, ℂ)} (hf : f ∈ representativeSubmodule G)
    (hh : h ∈ representativeSubmodule G) : f * h ∈ representativeSubmodule G

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.representative_one
statement: theorem representative_one : (1 : C(G, ℂ)) ∈ representativeSubmodule G

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.representative_star
statement:
theorem representative_star {f : C(G, ℂ)} (hf : f ∈ representativeSubmodule G) :
    star f ∈ representativeSubmodule G

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.HasMathieuProperty.of_surjective
statement:
theorem HasMathieuProperty.of_surjective (hG : HasMathieuProperty G)
    (π : G →* H) (hπ : Continuous π) (hs : Function.Surjective π) : HasMathieuProperty H

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.haar_integrable
statement: theorem haar_integrable (f : C(G, ℂ)) : Integrable f (normalizedHaar G)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.haar_pullback
statement:
theorem haar_pullback (π : G →* H) (hπ : Continuous π) (hs : Function.Surjective π)
    (f : C(H, ℂ)) :
    (∫ g, f (π g) ∂normalizedHaar G) = ∫ h, f h ∂normalizedHaar H

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.map_normalizedHaar
statement:
theorem map_normalizedHaar (π : G →* H) (hπ : Continuous π) (hs : Function.Surjective π) :
    Measure.map π (normalizedHaar G) = normalizedHaar H

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.not_mathieuProperty_of_quotient
statement:
theorem not_mathieuProperty_of_quotient (π : G →* H) (hπ : Continuous π)
    (hs : Function.Surjective π) (hH : ¬ HasMathieuProperty H) : ¬ HasMathieuProperty G

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.not_mathieu_of_representative_witness
statement:
theorem not_mathieu_of_representative_witness (f h : representativeFunctions (G := G))
    (hpure : ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → representativeIntegral G (f ^ m) = 0)
    (hmarked : ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → representativeIntegral G (h * f ^ m) ≠ 0) :
    ¬ HasMathieuProperty G

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.representativeIntegral_one
statement: theorem representativeIntegral_one : representativeIntegral G 1 = 1

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.representativeIntegral_pullback
statement:
theorem representativeIntegral_pullback (π : G →* H) (hπ : Continuous π)
    (hs : Function.Surjective π) (f : representativeFunctions (G := H)) :
    representativeIntegral G (representativePullback π hπ f) = representativeIntegral H f

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.representative_counterexample_pullback
statement:
theorem representative_counterexample_pullback (π : G →* H) (hπ : Continuous π)
    (hs : Function.Surjective π) (f h : representativeFunctions (G := H))
    (hpure : ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → representativeIntegral H (f ^ m) = 0)
    (hmarked : ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → representativeIntegral H (h * f ^ m) ≠ 0) :
    ¬ HasMathieuProperty G

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.specialize_C
statement:
@[simp] theorem specialize_C (x : ℂ) (f : ℂ[X]) :
    specialize x (LaurentPolynomial.C f) = LaurentPolynomial.C (f.eval x)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.specialize_T
statement:
@[simp] theorem specialize_T (x : ℂ) (n : ℤ) :
    specialize x (LaurentPolynomial.T n) = LaurentPolynomial.T n

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.specialize_coeff
statement:
@[simp] theorem specialize_coeff (x : ℂ) (f : Laurent) (k : ℤ) :
    (specialize x f).coeff k = (f.coeff k).eval x

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.circleEval_continuous
statement:
@[fun_prop] theorem circleEval_continuous (f : ScalarLaurent) :
    Continuous (fun z : Circle => circleEval z f)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.circleEval_monomial
statement:
theorem circleEval_monomial (z : Circle) (k : ℤ) (c : ℂ) :
    circleEval z (LaurentPolynomial.C c * LaurentPolynomial.T k) = c * (z : ℂ)^k

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.circle_constantTerm
statement:
theorem circle_constantTerm (f : ScalarLaurent) :
    (∫ z : Circle, circleEval z f ∂normalizedHaar Circle) = f.coeff 0

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.circle_zpow_integral
statement:
theorem circle_zpow_integral (k : ℤ) :
    (∫ z : Circle, (z : ℂ)^k ∂normalizedHaar Circle) = if k = 0 then 1 else 0

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.integral_eq_interval_circle
statement:
theorem integral_eq_interval_circle (f : Laurent) : integral f =
    ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, ∫ z : Circle, circleEval z (specialize (x : ℂ) f) ∂normalizedHaar Circle

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.basic_coeff
statement:
theorem basic_coeff (k : ℤ) : basic.coeff k =
    (if k = -1 then X - 1 else 0) +
    (if k = 0 then 1 - 2 * X else 0) +
    (if k = 1 then X else 0)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.basic_expansion
statement:
theorem basic_expansion : basic =
    LaurentPolynomial.C (X - 1) * LaurentPolynomial.T (-1) +
    LaurentPolynomial.C (1 - 2 * X) +
    LaurentPolynomial.C (X) * LaurentPolynomial.T 1

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.basic_marked
statement:
theorem basic_marked (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    integral (LaurentPolynomial.T (-1) * basic ^ n) = (-1 : ℂ) ^ (n-1) / (n+1)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.basic_marked_ne_zero
statement:
theorem basic_marked_ne_zero (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    integral (LaurentPolynomial.T (-1) * basic ^ n) ≠ 0

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.basic_pure
statement: theorem basic_pure (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) : integral (basic ^ n) = 0

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.basic_specialize
statement: theorem basic_specialize (x : ℂ) : specialize x basic = xzFamily x

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.basic_spectrum
statement: theorem basic_spectrum : basic.coeff.support = {-1, 0, 1}

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.basic_xz
statement:
theorem basic_xz :
    (∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → integral (basic ^ n) = 0) ∧
    (∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → integral (LaurentPolynomial.T (-1) * basic ^ n) =
      (-1 : ℂ) ^ (n-1) / (n+1)) ∧
    basic.coeff.support = {-1,0,1} ∧ ¬ XZConjecture ∧
    ¬ IsMathieuSubspace (LinearMap.ker integralLinear)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.basic_zero_mem_convexHull
statement:
theorem basic_zero_mem_convexHull : (0 : ℝ) ∈
    convexHull ℝ ((fun k : ℤ => (k : ℝ)) '' (basic.coeff.support : Set ℤ))

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.kernel_not_mathieu
statement: theorem kernel_not_mathieu : ¬ IsMathieuSubspace (LinearMap.ker integralLinear)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.not_XZConjecture
statement: theorem not_XZConjecture : ¬ XZConjecture

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.circuitMap_C
statement:
theorem circuitMap_C (d : ℤ) (μ : ℂ) (hμ : μ ≠ 0) (p : ℂ[X]) :
    circuitMap d μ hμ (LC p) = LC p

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.circuitMap_T
statement:
theorem circuitMap_T (d k : ℤ) (μ : ℂ) (hμ : μ ≠ 0) :
    circuitMap d μ hμ (LT k) = LC (C (μ ^ (-k))) * LT (d*k)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.circuitMap_coeff
statement:
theorem circuitMap_coeff (d : ℤ) (hd : d ≠ 0) (μ : ℂ) (hμ : μ ≠ 0)
    (f : Laurent) (k : ℤ) :
    (circuitMap d μ hμ f).coeff (d*k) = f.coeff k * C (μ ^ (-k))

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.circuitMap_single
statement:
theorem circuitMap_single (d k : ℤ) (μ : ℂ) (hμ : μ ≠ 0) (p : ℂ[X]) :
    circuitMap d μ hμ (LC p * LT k) = LC (p * C (μ ^ (-k))) * LT (d*k)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.circuit_coeff
statement:
theorem circuit_coeff (d k : ℤ) (lam μ : ℂ) (hμ : μ ≠ 0) :
    (circuit d lam μ).coeff k =
      (if k = d then C (lam*μ⁻¹) * X else 0) +
      (if k = 0 then C lam * (1-2*X) else 0) -
      (if k = -d then C (lam*μ) * (1-X) else 0)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.circuit_eq_map
statement:
theorem circuit_eq_map (d : ℤ) (lam μ : ℂ) (hμ : μ ≠ 0) :
    circuit d lam μ = LC (C lam) * circuitMap d μ hμ basic

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.circuit_expansion
statement:
theorem circuit_expansion (d : ℤ) (lam μ : ℂ) (hμ : μ ≠ 0) :
    circuit d lam μ = LC (C (lam*μ⁻¹) * X) * LT d + LC (C lam * (1-2*X)) -
      LC (C (lam*μ) * (1-X)) * LT (-d)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.circuit_family
statement:
theorem circuit_family (d : ℤ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (lam μ : ℂ) (hlam : lam ≠ 0) (hμ : μ ≠ 0) :
    (circuit d lam μ).coeff.support = {-d,0,d} ∧
    (∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → integral (circuit d lam μ ^ n) = 0) ∧
    (∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → integral (LT (-d) * circuit d lam μ ^ n) =
      (-1 : ℂ)^(n-1) * lam^n * μ⁻¹ / (n+1))

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.circuit_marked
statement:
theorem circuit_marked (d : ℤ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (lam μ : ℂ) (hμ : μ ≠ 0)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    integral (LT (-d) * circuit d lam μ ^ n) = (-1 : ℂ)^(n-1) * lam^n * μ⁻¹ / (n+1)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.circuit_marked_ne_zero
statement:
theorem circuit_marked_ne_zero (d : ℤ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (lam μ : ℂ)
    (hlam : lam ≠ 0) (hμ : μ ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    integral (LT (-d) * circuit d lam μ ^ n) ≠ 0

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.circuit_moment_coeff
statement:
theorem circuit_moment_coeff (d : ℤ) (hd : d ≠ 0) (lam μ : ℂ) (hμ : μ ≠ 0)
    (n : ℕ) (k : ℤ) :
    (circuit d lam μ ^ n).coeff (d*k) = C (lam^n * μ^(-k)) * (basic ^ n).coeff k

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.circuit_pure
statement:
theorem circuit_pure (d : ℤ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (lam μ : ℂ) (hμ : μ ≠ 0)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) : integral (circuit d lam μ ^ n) = 0

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.circuit_spectrum
statement:
theorem circuit_spectrum (d : ℤ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (lam μ : ℂ) (hlam : lam ≠ 0) (hμ : μ ≠ 0) :
    (circuit d lam μ).coeff.support = {-d,0,d}

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.integrable_orbit_function
statement:
theorem integrable_orbit_function (μ : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (hμ : IsCompact μ.support) {f : X → ℂ} (hf : Continuous f) :
    Integrable (fun p : G × X => f (p.1 • p.2)) ((normalizedHaar G).prod μ)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.measurePreserving_smul_prod
statement:
theorem measurePreserving_smul_prod (μ : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    [SMulInvariantMeasure G X μ] :
    MeasurePreserving (fun p : G × X => p.1 • p.2) ((normalizedHaar G).prod μ) μ

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.orbit_average
statement:
theorem orbit_average (μ : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [SMulInvariantMeasure G X μ]
    (hμ : IsCompact μ.support) {f : X → ℂ} (hf : Continuous f) :
    (∫ x, (∫ g, f (g • x) ∂normalizedHaar G) ∂μ) = ∫ x, f x ∂μ

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.orbit_average_integrable
statement:
theorem orbit_average_integrable (μ : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    [SMulInvariantMeasure G X μ] {f : X → ℂ} (hf : Integrable f μ) :
    (∫ x, (∫ g, f (g • x) ∂normalizedHaar G) ∂μ) = ∫ x, f x ∂μ

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.measurePreserving_transitive_orbit
statement:
theorem measurePreserving_transitive_orbit (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    [SMulInvariantMeasure G X μ]
    (htrans : ∀ x y : X, ∃ g : G, g • x = y) (z : X) :
    MeasurePreserving (fun g : G => g • z) (normalizedHaar G) μ

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.a_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem a_eq_zero_iff (z : Space) : a z = 0 ↔ z = 0

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.a_nonneg

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.a_smul

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.continuous_a
statement: @[fun_prop] theorem continuous_a : Continuous a

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.euclideanSurface_ne_zero
statement: theorem euclideanSurface_ne_zero : euclideanSurface ≠ 0

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.norm_sq_eq_a
statement: theorem norm_sq_eq_a (z : EuclideanPair) : ‖z‖ ^ 2 = a (WithLp.ofLp z)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.euclideanSurface_preserving
statement:
theorem euclideanSurface_preserving (e : EuclideanPair ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] EuclideanPair) :

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.surfaceMeasure_preserving
statement:
theorem surfaceMeasure_preserving (e : EuclideanPair ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] EuclideanPair) :
    MeasurePreserving (sphereAction e) surfaceMeasure surfaceMeasure

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.surface_cone_preimage
statement:
theorem surface_cone_preimage (e : EuclideanPair ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] EuclideanPair)
    (S : Set (Metric.sphere (0 : EuclideanPair) 1)) :
    Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 • (Subtype.val '' (euclideanSphereAction e ⁻¹' S)) =
      e ⁻¹' (Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 • (Subtype.val '' S))

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.SU2_transitive_sphere
statement: theorem SU2_transitive_sphere (z w : Sphere) : ∃ g : SU2, g • z = w

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.sphereMatrix_mem
statement: theorem sphereMatrix_mem (z : Sphere) : sphereMatrix z ∈ Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.sphereToSU2_smul
statement: theorem sphereToSU2_smul (z : Sphere) : sphereToSU2 z • ((1, 0) : Space) = z.val

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.su2Linear_a
statement: theorem su2Linear_a (g : SU2) (z : Space) : a (su2Linear g z) = a z

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.su2Linear_apply
statement:
theorem su2Linear_apply (g : SU2) (z : Space) :
    su2Linear g z = (g.val 0 0 * z.1 + g.val 0 1 * z.2,
      g.val 1 0 * z.1 + g.val 1 1 * z.2)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.su2Linear_mul
statement:
theorem su2Linear_mul (g h : SU2) (z : Space) :
    su2Linear (g * h) z = su2Linear g (su2Linear h z)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.su2Linear_one
statement: theorem su2Linear_one (z : Space) : su2Linear 1 z = z

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.su2_entries
statement:
theorem su2_entries (g : SU2) :
    g.val 0 1 = -star (g.val 1 0) ∧ g.val 1 1 = star (g.val 0 0)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.su2_first_column
statement: theorem su2_first_column (g : SU2) : a (g.val 0 0, g.val 1 0) = 1

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.su2_smul_apply
statement:
theorem su2_smul_apply (g : SU2) (z : Space) :
    g • z = (g.val 0 0 * z.1 + g.val 0 1 * z.2,
      g.val 1 0 * z.1 + g.val 1 1 * z.2)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.su2_smul_val
statement: theorem su2_smul_val (g : SU2) (z : Sphere) : (g • z).val = g • z.val

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.su2_sphereAction
statement: theorem su2_sphereAction (g : SU2) (z : Sphere) : sphereAction (su2Isometry g) z = g • z

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.su2_star_eq_adjugate
statement: theorem su2_star_eq_adjugate (g : SU2) : star g.val = g.val.adjugate

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.su2_surfaceMeasure_preserving
statement:
theorem su2_surfaceMeasure_preserving (g : SU2) :
    MeasurePreserving (fun z : Sphere => g • z) surfaceMeasure surfaceMeasure

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.SU2_transitive_equal_a
statement: theorem SU2_transitive_equal_a (z w : Space) (h : a z = a w) : ∃ g : SU2, g • z = w

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.exists_radial_direction
statement:
theorem exists_radial_direction (z : Space) :
    ∃ r : ℝ, 0 ≤ r ∧ ∃ w : Sphere, z = (r : ℂ) • w.val ∧ r ^ 2 = a z

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.su2_orbit_integral
statement:
theorem su2_orbit_integral (z : Sphere) {f : Sphere → ℂ} (hf : Continuous f) :
    (∫ g : SU2, f (g • z) ∂normalizedHaar SU2) = ∫ w, f w ∂surfaceMeasure

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.su2_orbit_map
statement:
theorem su2_orbit_map (z : Sphere) :
    Measure.map (fun g : SU2 => g • z) (normalizedHaar SU2) = surfaceMeasure

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.su2_orbit_measurePreserving
statement:
theorem su2_orbit_measurePreserving (z : Sphere) :
    MeasurePreserving (fun g : SU2 => g • z) (normalizedHaar SU2) surfaceMeasure

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.su2_smul_complex
statement:
theorem su2_smul_complex (g : SU2) (c : ℂ) (z : Space) :
    g • (c • z) = c • (g • z)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.continuous_sphereMonomial
statement:
@[fun_prop] theorem continuous_sphereMonomial (α β γ δ : ℕ) :
    Continuous (sphereMonomial α β γ δ)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.coordinateMonomial_real_smul
statement:
theorem coordinateMonomial_real_smul (α β γ δ : ℕ) (r : ℝ) (z : Space) :
    coordinateMonomial α β γ δ ((r : ℂ) • z) =
      (r : ℂ) ^ (α + β + γ + δ) * coordinateMonomial α β γ δ z

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.coordinateMonomial_scaled_integral_zero
statement:
theorem coordinateMonomial_scaled_integral_zero (α β γ δ : ℕ)
    (h : α + δ ≠ β + γ) (v : Space) :
    (∫ z : Sphere, coordinateMonomial α β γ δ (scaledSU2Action v z.val) ∂surfaceMeasure) = 0

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.diagonalPhase_smul
statement:
theorem diagonalPhase_smul (θ : ℝ) (z : Sphere) :
    (diagonalPhase θ • z).val =
      (Complex.exp (Complex.I * θ) * z.val.1,
        star (Complex.exp (Complex.I * θ)) * z.val.2)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.normSq_phase
statement:
theorem normSq_phase (r θ : ℝ) :
    Complex.normSq ((r : ℂ) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * θ)) = r ^ 2

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.scaledSU2Action_real_smul
statement:
theorem scaledSU2Action_real_smul (r : ℝ) (v z : Space) :
    scaledSU2Action ((r : ℂ) • v) z = (r : ℂ) • scaledSU2Action v z

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.scaledSU2Action_unit
statement:
theorem scaledSU2Action_unit (w : Sphere) (z : Space) :
    scaledSU2Action w.val z = sphereToSU2 w • z

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.sphereMonomial_integral_zero
statement:
theorem sphereMonomial_integral_zero (α β γ δ : ℕ) (h : α + δ ≠ β + γ) :
    (∫ z, sphereMonomial α β γ δ z ∂surfaceMeasure) = 0

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.sphereMonomial_phase
statement:
theorem sphereMonomial_phase (α β γ δ : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) (z : Sphere) :
    sphereMonomial α β γ δ (diagonalPhase θ • z) =
      Complex.exp (((α : ℂ) + δ - β - γ) * Complex.I * θ) * sphereMonomial α β γ δ z

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.firstCoordinate_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem firstCoordinate_apply (z : Sphere) : firstCoordinate z = z.val.1

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.mixedMoment_balance
statement:
theorem mixedMoment_balance (p q : ℕ) :
    (q + 1 : ℂ) * mixedMoment (p + 1) q = (p + 1 : ℂ) * mixedMoment p (q + 1)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.mixedMoment_factorial
statement:
theorem mixedMoment_factorial (p q : ℕ) :
    mixedMoment p q = (p.factorial : ℂ) * q.factorial / (p + q + 1).factorial

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.mixedMoment_partition
statement:
theorem mixedMoment_partition (p q : ℕ) :
    mixedMoment p q = mixedMoment (p + 1) q + mixedMoment p (q + 1)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.mixedMoment_succ_left
statement:
theorem mixedMoment_succ_left (p q : ℕ) :
    mixedMoment (p + 1) q = (p + 1 : ℂ) / (p + q + 2 : ℂ) * mixedMoment p q

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.mixedMoment_succ_right
statement:
theorem mixedMoment_succ_right (p q : ℕ) :
    mixedMoment p (q + 1) = (q + 1 : ℂ) / (p + q + 2 : ℂ) * mixedMoment p q

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.mixedMoment_zero_zero
statement: theorem mixedMoment_zero_zero : mixedMoment 0 0 = 1

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.rotationMomentPolynomial_eval
statement:
theorem rotationMomentPolynomial_eval (p q : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (z : Sphere) :
    (rotationMomentPolynomial p q).eval (ContinuousMap.const Sphere (t : ℂ)) z =
      coordinateMonomial (p + 1) p q (q + 1) (scaledSU2Action (1, (t : ℂ)) z.val)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.secondCoordinate_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem secondCoordinate_apply (z : Sphere) : secondCoordinate z = z.val.2

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.sphereMonomial_integrable
statement:
theorem sphereMonomial_integrable (α β γ δ : ℕ) :
    Integrable (sphereMonomial α β γ δ) surfaceMeasure

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.balanced_entry_integral
statement:
theorem balanced_entry_integral (r s t : ℕ) :
    (∫ g : SU2, entryMonomial r s t r g ∂normalizedHaar SU2) =
      if s = t then (-1 : ℂ)^s * ((r.factorial : ℂ) * s.factorial / (r+s+1).factorial) else 0

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.continuous_entryMonomial
statement:
@[fun_prop] theorem continuous_entryMonomial (r s t u : ℕ) :
    Continuous (entryMonomial r s t u)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.entryMonomial_integral_diagonal
statement:
theorem entryMonomial_integral_diagonal (r s : ℕ) :
    (∫ g : SU2, entryMonomial r s s r g ∂normalizedHaar SU2) =
      (-1 : ℂ)^s * ((r.factorial : ℂ) * s.factorial / (r+s+1).factorial)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.entryMonomial_integral_left_zero
statement:
theorem entryMonomial_integral_left_zero (r s t u : ℕ) (h : r+t ≠ u+s) :
    (∫ g : SU2, entryMonomial r s t u g ∂normalizedHaar SU2) = 0

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.entryMonomial_integral_right_zero
statement:
theorem entryMonomial_integral_right_zero (r s t u : ℕ) (h : r+s ≠ t+u) :
    (∫ g : SU2, entryMonomial r s t u g ∂normalizedHaar SU2) = 0

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.entryMonomial_right_phase
statement:
theorem entryMonomial_right_phase (r s t u : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) (g : SU2) :
    entryMonomial r s t u (g * diagonalPhase θ) =
      Complex.exp (((r : ℂ)+s-t-u)*Complex.I*θ) * entryMonomial r s t u g

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.entryMonomial_sphere
statement:
theorem entryMonomial_sphere (r s t u : ℕ) (g : SU2) :
    entryMonomial r s t u g = (-1 : ℂ)^t * sphereMonomial r u s t (su2ToSphere g)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.su2Entry_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem su2Entry_apply (i j : Fin 2) (g : SU2) : (su2Entry i j).val g = g.val i j

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.su2_determinant_relation
statement:
theorem su2_determinant_relation (g : SU2) :
    g.val 0 0 * g.val 1 1 - g.val 1 0 * g.val 0 1 = 1

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.su2_firstColumn_integral
statement:
theorem su2_firstColumn_integral {f : Sphere → ℂ} (hf : Continuous f) :
    (∫ g : SU2, f (su2ToSphere g) ∂normalizedHaar SU2) = ∫ z, f z ∂surfaceMeasure

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.su2_monomial
statement:
theorem su2_monomial (r s t u : ℕ) :
    (∫ g : SU2, entryMonomial r s t u g ∂normalizedHaar SU2) =
      if r = u ∧ s = t then
        (-1 : ℂ)^s * ((r.factorial : ℂ)*s.factorial/(r+s+1).factorial) else 0

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.su2_smul_basePoint
statement: theorem su2_smul_basePoint (g : SU2) : g • basePoint = su2ToSphere g

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.betaTriple_monomial
statement:
theorem betaTriple_monomial (e : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) (c : ℂ) :
    betaTriple (MvPolynomial.monomial e c) =
      LaurentPolynomial.C (C (c * (-1)^e 2) * (1-X)^e 0 * X^e 1) *
        LaurentPolynomial.T ((e 1 : ℤ) - e 2)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.betaTriple_monomial_integral
statement:
theorem betaTriple_monomial_integral (e : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) (c : ℂ) :
    integral (betaTriple (MvPolynomial.monomial e c)) =
      c * (if e 1 = e 2 then (-1 : ℂ)^e 1 *
        ((e 0).factorial * ((e 1).factorial : ℂ) / (e 0+e 1+1).factorial) else 0)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.entryTriple_monomial
statement:
theorem entryTriple_monomial (e : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) (c : ℂ) (g : SU2) :
    (entryTriple (MvPolynomial.monomial e c)).val g =
      c * entryMonomial (e 0) (e 1) (e 2) (e 0) g

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.su2_polynomial_transfer
statement:
theorem su2_polynomial_transfer (P : TriplePolynomial) :
    representativeIntegral SU2 (entryTriple P) = integral (betaTriple P)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.beta_factorial
statement:
theorem beta_factorial (r s : ℕ) :
    (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, (1-(x : ℂ))^r * (x : ℂ)^s) =
      (r.factorial : ℂ) * s.factorial / (r+s+1).factorial

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.betaAverage_add
statement:
theorem betaAverage_add (P Q : CoordinatePolynomial) (x : ℝ) :
    betaAverage (P+Q) x = betaAverage P x + betaAverage Q x

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.betaAverage_continuous
statement: theorem betaAverage_continuous (P : CoordinatePolynomial) : Continuous (betaAverage P)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.betaAverage_monomial
statement:
theorem betaAverage_monomial (e : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) (c : ℂ) (x : ℝ) :
    betaAverage (MvPolynomial.monomial e c) x =
      if e 0 = e 3 ∧ e 1 = e 2 then c * (-1 : ℂ)^e 1 * (1-(x : ℂ))^e 0 * (x : ℂ)^e 1 else 0

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.betaEval_add
statement:
theorem betaEval_add (P Q : CoordinatePolynomial) (x : ℝ) (z₁ z₂ : Circle) :
    betaEval (P+Q) x z₁ z₂ = betaEval P x z₁ z₂ + betaEval Q x z₁ z₂

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.betaEval_continuous
statement:
theorem betaEval_continuous (P : CoordinatePolynomial) :
    Continuous (fun v : (ℝ × Circle) × Circle => betaEval P v.1.1 v.1.2 v.2)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.betaEval_monomial
statement:
theorem betaEval_monomial (e : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) (c : ℂ) (x : ℝ) (z₁ z₂ : Circle) :
    betaEval (MvPolynomial.monomial e c) x z₁ z₂ =
      (c * (-1 : ℂ)^e 2 * (1-(x : ℂ))^e 0 * (x : ℂ)^e 1) *
        (z₁ : ℂ)^((e 1 : ℤ)-e 2) * (z₂ : ℂ)^((e 0 : ℤ)-e 3)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.betaInner_continuous
statement:
theorem betaInner_continuous (P : CoordinatePolynomial) :
    Continuous (fun v : ℝ × Circle => ∫ z₂, betaEval P v.1 v.2 z₂ ∂normalizedHaar Circle)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.betaIntegral_add
statement: theorem betaIntegral_add (P Q : CoordinatePolynomial) : betaIntegral (P+Q) = betaIntegral P + betaIntegral Q

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.betaIntegral_monomial
statement:
theorem betaIntegral_monomial (e : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) (c : ℂ) :
    betaIntegral (MvPolynomial.monomial e c) = c *
      (if e 0 = e 3 ∧ e 1 = e 2 then
        (-1 : ℂ)^e 1 * ((e 0).factorial * ((e 1).factorial : ℂ) / (e 0+e 1+1).factorial) else 0)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.entryCoordinates_apply
statement:
theorem entryCoordinates_apply (P : CoordinatePolynomial) (g : SU2) :
    (entryCoordinates P).val g =
      MvPolynomial.eval ![g.val 0 0, g.val 1 0, g.val 0 1, g.val 1 1] P

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.entryCoordinates_monomial
statement:
theorem entryCoordinates_monomial (e : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) (c : ℂ) (g : SU2) :
    (entryCoordinates (MvPolynomial.monomial e c)).val g =
      c * entryMonomial (e 0) (e 1) (e 2) (e 3) g

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.su2_integration
statement:
theorem su2_integration (P : CoordinatePolynomial) :
    representativeIntegral SU2 (entryCoordinates P) = betaIntegral P

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.su2_integration_formula
statement:
theorem su2_integration_formula (P : CoordinatePolynomial) :
    (∫ g : SU2, MvPolynomial.eval ![g.val 0 0, g.val 1 0, g.val 0 1, g.val 1 1] P
      ∂normalizedHaar SU2) =
    ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, ∫ z₁ : Circle, ∫ z₂ : Circle,
      MvPolynomial.eval ![(1-(x : ℂ))*(z₂ : ℂ), (x : ℂ)*(z₁ : ℂ),
        -(z₁ : ℂ)⁻¹, (z₂ : ℂ)⁻¹] P ∂normalizedHaar Circle ∂normalizedHaar Circle

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.continuous_circle_integral
XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.alternating_partial_row
statement:
theorem alternating_partial_row (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (-1 : ℂ)^k * n.choose k) = (-1 : ℂ)^(n-1)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.alternating_row
statement:
theorem alternating_row (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n+1), (-1 : ℂ)^k * n.choose k) = 0

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.cancellation_mechanism
statement:
theorem cancellation_mechanism (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n+1), (-1 : ℂ)^k * n.choose k) = 0 ∧
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (-1 : ℂ)^k * n.choose k) = (-1 : ℂ)^(n-1) ∧
    integral (basic^n) = 0 ∧ integral (LaurentPolynomial.T (-1) * basic^n) ≠ 0

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.generating_radicand
statement:
theorem generating_radicand (x t : ℂ) :
    (1-t*(1-2*x))^2 + 4*t^2*x*(1-x) = (1-t)^2 + 4*t*x

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.momentSeries_eq_one
statement: theorem momentSeries_eq_one : momentSeries = 1

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.all_mixed_xz
statement:
theorem all_mixed_xz (k l : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hl : 1 ≤ l) :
    ¬ MixedXZConjecture k l ∧ ¬ IsMathieuSubspace (LinearMap.ker (multiIntegralLinear k l))

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.cube_polynomial_integrable
statement:
theorem cube_polynomial_integrable {l : ℕ} (p : MvPolynomial (Fin l) ℂ) :
    Integrable (fun x : Fin l → ℝ => MvPolynomial.eval (fun i => (x i : ℂ)) p) (cubeMeasure l)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.padCoefficient_eval
statement:
theorem padCoefficient_eval {l : ℕ} (i : Fin l) (p : ℂ[X]) (x : Fin l → ℝ) :
    MvPolynomial.eval (fun j => (x j : ℂ)) (padCoefficient i p) = p.eval (x i : ℂ)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.padExponent_injective
statement: theorem padExponent_injective {k : ℕ} (j : Fin k) : Function.Injective (padExponent j)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.pad_coeff
statement:
theorem pad_coeff {k l : ℕ} (j : Fin k) (i : Fin l) (f : Laurent) (n : ℤ) :
    (pad j i f).coeff (padExponent j n) = padCoefficient i (f.coeff n)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.pad_integral
statement:
theorem pad_integral {k l : ℕ} (j : Fin k) (i : Fin l) (f : Laurent) :
    multiIntegral (pad j i f) = integral f

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.pad_monomial
statement:
theorem pad_monomial {k l : ℕ} (j : Fin k) (i : Fin l) (n : ℤ) (p : ℂ[X]) :
    pad j i (LaurentPolynomial.C p * LaurentPolynomial.T n) =
      AddMonoidAlgebra.single (padExponent j n) (padCoefficient i p)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.padded_zero_support
statement:
theorem padded_zero_support {k l : ℕ} (j : Fin k) (i : Fin l) :
    (0 : Fin k → ℤ) ∈ (pad j i basic).coeff.support

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.multiCircle_constantTerm
statement:
theorem multiCircle_constantTerm {k l : ℕ} (x : Fin l → ℝ) (f : MultiLaurent k l) :
    (∫ z, multiEval x z f ∂torusMeasure k) = MvPolynomial.eval (fun i => (x i : ℂ)) (f.coeff 0)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.multiEval_continuous
statement:
theorem multiEval_continuous {k l : ℕ} (x : Fin l → ℝ) (f : MultiLaurent k l) :
    Continuous (fun z : Fin k → Circle => multiEval x z f)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.multiEval_single
statement:
theorem multiEval_single {k l : ℕ} (x : Fin l → ℝ) (z : Fin k → Circle)
    (e : Fin k → ℤ) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin l) ℂ) :
    multiEval x z (AddMonoidAlgebra.single e p) =
      MvPolynomial.eval (fun i => (x i : ℂ)) p * ∏ j, (z j : ℂ)^(e j)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.pad_eval
statement:
theorem pad_eval {k l : ℕ} (j : Fin k) (i : Fin l) (f : Laurent)
    (x : Fin l → ℝ) (z : Fin k → Circle) :
    multiEval x z (pad j i f) = circleEval (z j) (specialize (x i : ℂ) f)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.SU2_not_mathieu
statement: theorem SU2_not_mathieu : ¬ HasMathieuProperty SU2

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.betaTriple_F
statement: theorem betaTriple_F (lam μ : ℂ) : betaTriple (FPolynomial lam μ) = circuit 1 lam μ

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.betaTriple_G
statement: theorem betaTriple_G : betaTriple GPolynomial = LaurentPolynomial.T (-1)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.small_pair
statement:
theorem small_pair (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    (∫ g : SU2, ((1+g.val 0 1) * (g.val 0 0*g.val 1 1+g.val 1 0))^n ∂normalizedHaar SU2) = 0 ∧
    (∫ g : SU2, ((1+g.val 0 1) * (g.val 0 0*g.val 1 1+g.val 1 0))^n * (-g.val 0 1)
      ∂normalizedHaar SU2) = (-1 : ℂ)^(n-1)/(n+1)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.su2F_apply
statement:
theorem su2F_apply (lam μ : ℂ) (g : SU2) :
    (su2F lam μ).val g = lam * (1 + μ * g.val 0 1) *
      (g.val 0 0 * g.val 1 1 + μ⁻¹ * g.val 1 0)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.su2G_apply
statement: theorem su2G_apply (g : SU2) : su2G.val g = -g.val 0 1

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.su2_counterexample
statement:
theorem su2_counterexample (lam μ : ℂ) (hlam : lam ≠ 0) (hμ : μ ≠ 0) :
    (∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n →
      (∫ g : SU2, (lam * (1+μ*g.val 0 1) *
        (g.val 0 0*g.val 1 1 + μ⁻¹*g.val 1 0))^n ∂normalizedHaar SU2) = 0) ∧
    (∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n →
      (∫ g : SU2, (lam * (1+μ*g.val 0 1) *
        (g.val 0 0*g.val 1 1 + μ⁻¹*g.val 1 0))^n * (-g.val 0 1) ∂normalizedHaar SU2) =
          (-1 : ℂ)^(n-1) * lam^n * μ⁻¹ / (n+1)) ∧
    (∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → (-1 : ℂ)^(n-1) * lam^n * μ⁻¹ / (n+1) ≠ 0) ∧
    ¬ HasMathieuProperty SU2

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.su2_marked
statement:
theorem su2_marked (lam μ : ℂ) (hμ : μ ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    representativeIntegral SU2 (su2G * su2F lam μ ^ n) =
      (-1 : ℂ)^(n-1) * lam^n * μ⁻¹ / (n+1)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.su2_marked_ne_zero
statement:
theorem su2_marked_ne_zero (lam μ : ℂ) (hlam : lam ≠ 0) (hμ : μ ≠ 0)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) : representativeIntegral SU2 (su2G * su2F lam μ ^ n) ≠ 0

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.su2_pure
statement:
theorem su2_pure (lam μ : ℂ) (hμ : μ ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    representativeIntegral SU2 (su2F lam μ ^ n) = 0
